scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Hello!
What's up?
I'm a specialist
for refining items,
but I don't work anymore.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你好！
最近怎麼樣？
我是專門負責精煉裝備的，
不過我現在已經不再工作了。

scripts.text: I'll go on my way.
scripts.translation: 我先走了。

scripts.text: Hmm... this makes me curious.
scripts.translation: 嗯...這讓我很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Take care, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
保重，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Actually, I sometimes provide refine services for adventurers with a ^006400Refine Ticket^000000...
Bye bye~!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
其實，我偶爾也會為持有^006400精煉券^000000的冒險者提供精煉服務...
再見啦~！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Greetings!
I can refine an item up to the ^006400same level as your ticket^000000.
You don't have to worry! There's no chance of breaking your item.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你好！
我可以將裝備精煉到^006400與你的精煉券相同的等級^000000。
請放心！裝備不會損壞。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text: Refine item with ticket.
scripts.translation: 使用精煉券精煉裝備。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Okay.
You can come again later.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
好的。
你稍後可以再來。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Which equipment would you like to refine?
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你想精煉哪件裝備？

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
You have to equip the item you want to refine.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你必須裝備想要精煉的物品。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Oh, I'm sorry.
This item is impossible to refine.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
哦，抱歉。
這件物品無法精煉。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
If you want to refine this ^006400{0}^000000, please come along with ^006400{1} Refine Ticket^000000.
See you later!

[Refine Master]
Please choose which ^006400{0} Refine Ticket^000000 you want to use.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
請選擇你想使用哪張^006400{0}精煉券^000000。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
{0} is not in your inventory. Did you put it in your storage?
Please check again.
See you later!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
你的物品欄裡沒有{0}。你把它放進倉庫了嗎？
請再次確認。
回頭見！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
^8B4513This item is already refined as much as your deed.^000000
Please come along with an item refined less than your ticket.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
^8B4513這件裝備的精煉等級已經達到你的精煉券上限。^000000
請攜帶精煉等級低於精煉券上限的裝備過來。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
I'm going to refine ^006400{0}^8B4513 up to the +{1} level^000000 with ^006400{2}^000000.
May I proceed?
No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Oh, you changed your mind.
Ok.
You can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
哦，你改變主意了。
好的。
你稍後可以再來。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Great.
As you wish!
I have my own special way to refine...
.......ka boom!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
很好。
如你所願！
我有自己特殊的精煉方式...
.......轟！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Great.
As you wish!
I have my own special way to refine...
.......ka boom!
[Refine Master]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
很好。
如你所願！
我有自己特殊的精煉方式...
.......轟！
[精煉大師]
等一下...
你以為我傻嗎？！
趁我不注意你換了裝備！給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
Error!
Please report this.
scripts.translation:
錯誤！
請報告此問題。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Alright, here it is~
Well, ^0000FF{0}^000000!
Congratulations on your shining {1}.
You look GREAT!
Farewell~!
scripts.translation:
[精煉大師]
好了，給你~
哇，^0000FF{0}^000000！
恭喜你，你的{1}閃閃發光。
看起來真棒！
再見~！
